title: Protected evidence set
description: The unit of durability is an EVIDENCE CLOSURE, not a directory of ciphertext blobs. A stored object's layout is [12-byte nonce][16-byte tag][ciphertext] and carries no key-version field, so an object replicated without its ledger entry is DURABLE_BUT_UNDECRYPTABLE, which is a FAIL. The ledger is therefore a member of this set rather than adjacent metadata. The production/provisional split is permanently explicit: all 14005 physical objects are preserved, but only the 13998 ledger-bound objects are certified production until the 7 orphans are resolved.

PRODUCTION_EXPECTED_COUNT.description: Ledger-bound unique ciphertext. The only certified production population.

PROVISIONAL_EXPECTED_COUNT.description: Orphan ciphertext with no ledger association. Preserved, never certified.

PRESERVATION_EXPECTED_COUNT.description: Every physical object that must survive.

populationSplitIsExplicit.description: Separate manifests and separate receipt counts. Never collapsed into one total.

provisionalPromotedToProduction.description: Promotion is refused structurally. The orphans' missing ledger association is evidence and is never repaired by manufacturing an entry.

ledgerEntries.description: Immutable hash-chained entries. Required to bind ciphertext to key version.

ledgerChainMetadata.description: Chain head and linkage sufficient to rebuild ordering from the immutable entries.

reconciliationManifest.description: The adjudicated accounting authority required to reconstruct identity.

cryptoMetadata.description: Envelope version and key-version binding. Never key material.
